## Docs checklist

Docs ship with the code, in the same pull request:

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for this change (CI fails without one when `src/` changes)
- [ ] README updated where users will see it
- [ ] Every new public item has a doc comment with an example
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (the README examples are doctests)
